references.text: The gold plates and bowls used in the tabernacle, including dishes for incense, were described in the instructions for the sanctuary.
The description of the holy incense that was to be burned on the altar of incense, which this gold bowl was filled with.
Bezalel made vessels of pure gold for the sanctuary, including bowls for incense.
The first gold bowl filled with incense was given by Nahshon from the tribe of Judah, who established the pattern for all the tribes' offerings.
The summary of all twelve gold bowls filled with incense that were given by the tribal leaders.
Gold bowls filled with incense represent the prayers of the saints in heavenly worship.
Incense mixed with the prayers of the saints is offered on the golden altar before God's throne.
